transaction: parent state fingerprint; numeric state fingerprint; context and evidence hashes bound to certificate; atomic NPZ

support.nodal: original Q4 nodes; u interleaved x,y

displacement: accepted fresh mechanical equilibrium at final damage
damage: accepted box-QP solution; own old accepted damage is lower bound
accumulated: commit trial from fixed old accepted A,r and final u,d; once only
driver: commit (1-d_GP)^2 psi_raw(final u); current value, not history maximum
fatigue: f_commit=f(A_commit); accepted fresh check, not last QP input
f_solve_gp: actual coefficient in last solved damage QP, before final re-equilibrium
psi_raw_commit_gp: undegraded tensile energy from final accepted displacement
opaque: inherited unchanged; no physical update claimed
u_pred,psi_pred: common mechanical predictor at old damage, target load; before damage solve
NN_output: feasible damage initializer only; never accepted damage or teacher
d_target: accepted output damage; target only, never an input feature
